subject: Quick thought on your patient booking experience at The Hills Dental Spa
body: Hi team at The Hills Dental Spa, I recently came across your practice while looking into aesthetic and neuromuscular care in Austin. I really admire how Dr. Kevin Winters pairs advanced K7 diagnostics with true luxury spa amenities to deliver your 'Return to Yourself' philosophy. While browsing your current site, I noticed that mobile visitors could benefit from a more streamlined, sticky booking bar to quickly schedule consultations, and some of the denser service pages could be broken down into clearer modular sections for better reading flow. Because I specialize in clean web architecture, I took a bit of time to build a modern, high-performance prototype for you. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-preview.pages.dev/biz_0x865b3585bfa9d445_0x76e8240fc51b9e2e. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added a sticky mobile booking bar for better conversion tracking
Structured dense content blocks into clean, modular sections
